text:
chen_infra: Quick heads-up — scheduling a phased cohort rotation for az3 (gpu-pool-beta) on Wed 2026-03-25 02:00–04:30 UTC. Goal: apply NIC microcode + kernel patch, then reboot nodes; we'll warm KV caches after each cohort. Expected hit: ~6% available GPU capacity during the window.

maria_oncall: ETA on cohorts + how long each will be out?

chen_infra: 6 cohorts of ~20 nodes. Each cohort: 10m cordon, 20–30m reboot + verification, 15m cache-seed. Stagger start 15m between cohorts so overall window ~2.5h.

alex_sre: What fallback routing do we have if az3 latency spikes? Canary traffic to eu-west5 for chat-generation?

chen_infra: Yes — smart routing policy will redirect new requests to eu-west5 and us-west1 by priority. We'll keep a small canary in az3 after each cohort (5% traffic) to validate model latency.

sam_runtime: Cache-seed plan? We need to pre-populate KV prefixes for hot tenants (priority-tenants list). Otherwise first requests will be slow.

chen_infra: Good call. We'll run a KV-seed job after each cohort: seed keys for top 10% tenants + last-30m prefixes. Script: 
```
# after node becomes ready
python infra/scripts/kv_seed.py --pool gpu-pool-beta --top-tenants-file /tmp/top-tenants.txt 
```

ops_lead: Assigning on-call rota: Maria covers cohort 1–3, Alex covers 4–6. I'll own rollback coordination.

maria_oncall: ack. I'll put watchblocks on my calendar. Will raise page if 95th > 350ms for >5m.

alex_sre: What are the costs if we divert 6% capacity to backups + burst? Rough calc?

chen_infra: Rough estimate: backup egress + burst instances ~ $2.8k for the window (short-lived). Main cost is potential extra token compute if retries spike. I'll put a tighter limit: throttle burst to keep cost under $3.5k.

nora_pm: We'll need a short customer comms blurb & status page message. Suggested: "Planned maintenance in az3 may cause brief increases in latency for some workloads; routing and fallbacks enabled." Can ops draft?

maria_oncall: I'll draft a 2-line status msg and run it by Nora.

infra-bot: runbook 9351 linked: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/az3-rotation (steps, rollback, contact matrix).

deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket #INC-935123 created and scheduled for 2026-03-25T02:00Z. On-call: maria_oncall, alex_sre.

chen_infra: Preflight checklist (to run 2h before):
- verify backfill capacity in us-west1/eu-west5 >= 12%
- snapshot critical PVs for top 10 tenants
- ensure KV seed job packaged and smoke-tested
- confirm KMS key availability for private pools

maria_oncall: I'll run the PV snapshot + confirm KMS by 00:30 UTC.

alex_sre: Add healthcheck in the rollout job to verify model-serving process ready + token latency < 220ms before uncordoning. If not, auto-rollback cohort.

chen_infra: Implemented. Rollback criteria: >5% request errors for 5m OR 95th latency > 420ms for 3m.

ops_lead: If rollback happens, plan is: stop rotation, bring cohort nodes back, prefix-warm caches from backups, then retry after postmortem. Communicate to status page with markdown snippet.

nora_pm: Great. Put a short post-maint survey for platform teams to report regressions.

sam_runtime: One more: network egress quotas in az3 are near soft limit at night. We'll throttle KV-seed concurrency to avoid tripping egress caps. Add flag --concurrency=6 to script.

chen_infra: Done, will run seed with --concurrency=6 and 30s inter-key delay.

maria_oncall: I'll be in the channel during the window. Ping me @channel 5m before cohort starts.

chen_infra: Thanks — I'll post a final readiness ping 02:00 UTC and update ticket. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Notification: maintenance window starting in 10m for ticket #INC-935123.

maria_oncall: Ready.

alex_sre: Ready from my side, monitoring dashboards up.

ops_lead: Logged cost guard: hard cap $3.5k for window, will abort bursts beyond cap.

chen_infra: End of thread — will post updates live during ops.
